metadata.purpose: Storage probe E1 (v2): adding a NULLABLE column must preserve existing rows. Uses KeepExistingIfCompatible and forbids destructive recreate -- a probe that recreates cannot test preservation, which is the entire point of this one.
metadata.seedPath: Rows are seeded through the generated app's own CRUD endpoint, which is why this concept carries a ui label: without one the app emits no such endpoint and Tier C's seed 404s. Inserting over JDBC instead would prove the rows survive, but not that the platform wrote them (storage/OPEN_ITEMS_PLAN.md 5.1).
metadata.reservedIdentifierCoverage: The concept is `Row` (realized table `rows`, reserved on MySQL 8) and its field is `value` (reserved on H2). Both were renamed to `EvolveRow`/`label` while STOR-6 was open, because the generator never quoted business identifiers and this probe could not boot on either engine. STOR-6 is closed -- conditional quoting asks SqlDialect.identifier() at all three naming seams -- so the original names are back, and this probe now also covers that.
